## 5. Is 98 with no dimension below 9 arithmetically possible?

Weights sum to 100 and scores are out of 10, so `sum(score*weight/10)` maxes at 100; **all-dimensions-at-9 yields exactly 90, not 98.** Reaching 98 requires a weighted mean of 9.8 — mathematically possible only if the near-9 dimensions carry little weight and the bulk of weight sits on dimensions actually at ~10.
